text:
I've been coming to this clinic over the past two years and it has been a great experience every single time.
I had 2 wisdom teeth removed, one in 2024 and one in 2025, both by Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam. He was so professional and efficient. I was nervous both times, but he made the whole process feel quick and easy. Honestly, I was surprised how smoothly it all went.
This year I came back for several fillings, and Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk took great care of me. She is attentive, gentle and precise, exactly the kind of dentist you hope to find. I always felt completely comfortable and in good hands.
I also want to give a shoutout to the assistants, whose names I unfortunately don't know, but they were just as wonderful at every visit.

One thing I really appreciate about this clinic is the transparency. They always tell you the price before the procedure, no surprises or hidden fees.

I visited the clinic due to a long-standing toothache that had been bothering me for quite some time. As I had very limited time during my trip, I really appreciated how efficiently the reception staff arranged my appointment.

The dentist provided clear and thorough explanations, the pricing was reasonable, and the clinic was clean and well-maintained.

Overall, I had a great experience and will definitely return again next year.

From the moment I arrived, I felt genuinely well taken care of. The entire team was kind, attentive, and professional. The atmosphere in the clinic was calm and welcoming – exactly what you hope for when going to the dentist.

Everything was explained clearly, and all of my questions were answered with patience. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable. I especially appreciated the gentle and focused approach of the dentist – it really made a difference.

I’m very happy with the result and will definitely come back. Thank you to the whole team – highly recommended!

This morning I had the pleasure of visiting Edelweiss Dental House Sukhumvit 15 branch, and I can't recommend them enough! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by how welcoming and friendly the reception staff where (with a special mention to Wasinee 🤗) —they made the entire experience feel warm and inviting. I was able to walk in and make an appointment, which was incredibly convenient.

The clinic itself is spotless, giving me instant confidence in their commitment to hygiene and patient care. When I met the dentist Dr Jirapat Jaroonvechatam and his assistant they were incredibly professional and took the time to thoroughly explain everything about the cleaning, polishing, and filling procedures. I felt fully informed and at ease throughout the entire process. Also the attentiveness in giving me a cosy blanket put me at more ease.

The filling procedure was surprisingly quick and painless, which I really appreciated—no discomfort at all! Infact I didn't even realise the injection for the numbing of my gum had happened, Dr Jirapat is so gentle, offering me cleaning advice after the procedure. On top of all that excellent service, the pricing is extremely reasonable for the level of care provided. Overall, this has been the best experience I have ever had at a Dentist and will definitely be returning for my future dental needs. Highly recommend this clinic!

The experience from booking online to attending the first appointment was a breeze. Clear & thorough information given before confirming on any appointments.

Super friendly staff, which made the whole experience memorable and I looked forward to the following appointments 😀

Consultation included a thorough check up & planning. I was able to get cleaning & polishing too with this appointment.

The service provided was spectacular 👌

I came in for a dental scaling, and I’m very afraid of dentists. However, the dentist took excellent care of me—explaining each step in detail, working very gently, and truly understanding someone like me who is nervous about dental treatment.

Another thing that impressed me was how friendly and welcoming the reception staff were; they were always smiling. I’m very impressed with the service here and would highly recommend this place.

Just had a great visit to Edelweiss Dental House Sukhumvit 15 branch and such a lovely experience.
We emailed prior to leaving the UK to explain what we needed, they always replied promptly and the pricing structure was very clear.
All the staff were lovely and spoke perfect English, they explained everything clearly before commencing treatment and explained how much it would cost.
They were also very accommodating in arranging a second appointment very quickly for me as I needed more specialist treatment.
The price and quality of treatment is significantly better than back home in the UK.
Highly recommend visiting here for any dental treatments and check ups

I had a terrible experience here.

I came initially because they pay influencers to promote to expats, but do not be fooled.

I came for routine fillings that I have had replaced many times in different offices all over the world with zero problems.   For my front tooth, I informed Dr. Kittipat Termteerapornpimol I have thin enamel and sensitivity on my front teeth, but he was completely dismissive of my anxieties.  He then proceeded to grind and sand off the front of my enamel over 2/3 of my tooth surface.  The next day, pain and increased sensitivity.

Doctor showed zero concern or remorse.   I did not seek a refund or follow up work.  After going to TDH you could not pay me to return here.

Enamel does not regenerate, do not risk it.  If you come here copy/paste this name:  Dr. Kittipat Termteerapornpimol and request a different doctor.

Or better yet, spend the tiny bit more and go to TDH. Better safe than sorry.
From email booking to service date, all went extremely smoothly and professionally. …

I came to use the service here. The doctor and staff are very friendly and lovely. The treatment prices are reasonable, and the waiting time is not long. I would definitely recommend this place to others!!

So generally I hate going to the dentist and get quite nervous but my experience here has been awesome.
I really can’t recommend it enough.
All the staff are lovely and they make you feel so welcome.
The ladies out the front also very kindly recommended an excellent nail place a few doors down. Winning!

My dentist was a magician with my fillings and he and the technician were so kind, they made the whole experience very pleasant as well as pain free for me which was much appreciated.

The price was really reasonable too.

I will definitely be back, in the morning actually :)

I was very impressed they did an amazing job I'm very happy with the results
The people there spoke very good English and explained everything extremely well
Terry from Australia

I’m really happy I chose this clinic! The service was excellent, and they communicated with me perfectly in English which was much appreciated krub. The doctor provided great advice, the staff was really polite and the results of the cleaning service were fantastic. I definitely recommend this clinic! Thanks guys! 🙏🏻 …

Edelweiss Dental is fantastic. Dr. Kantaporn Kunpanichakit and her assistant, Yada, took outstanding care of my 6-year-old. She needed an extraction and a spacer. They explained each step, spoke gently, and kept her calm from start to finish. The office is very clean. Pricing was clear and fair. Reception is kind and always gives her a little gift. Communication is fast and helpful. I trust them with my child’s care and highly recommend this clinic.

I wanted to get my teeth cleaned here in Bangkok and found this place on Google Maps close to my hotel.

Was able to get a same day appointment and offered water both times in the lobby while waiting.

During my initial dental check up 4 cavities were discovered and recommended to be treated.

I was happy to go ahead with that and the original cleaning I wanted.

The whole process was straightforward and painless. Approximately 5 minutes to treat each tooth and 15 minutes or so to clean.

Glad I chose here. Prices are good and there’s a clear commitment to care from start to finish.

I paid the equivalent of £150. Back home in the UK I had to pay almost £300 for just cleaning and 2 teeth to be treated on private treatment once.

Thanks to all involved. Would definitely return for any more health or cosmetic work needed in future.

I recently had the best dental experience at this clinic! After years of feeling insecure about my teeth due to previous experiences with Western European dentists who often suggested unnecessary procedures for profit, I finally found a place that truly prioritizes patients well-being. Dr. Jirapat was incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely caring, making me feel comfortable and confident about my dental health. The entire staff was warm and welcoming, creating a friendly and relaxing environment. Scheduling was also a breeze with quick appointment availability, which made the process even smoother. This clinic offers the highest quality service I’ve ever experienced, and I can’t recommend them enough!
I come for my annual health check-up every year. The price is very reasonable, and the care from doctors and staff remains excellent as always.

Dear Edelweiss Dental House,

My young daughter and I visited your Sukhumvit 15 branch on June 13, following a recommendation from my wife’s colleague at Olympus (Thailand).

I want to express our sincere appreciation for the outstanding care from Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam and Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk. Both embody the philosophy of treating patients like family, providing personalized and precise care.

To Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk:
Thank you for your kindness and patience with my tween daughter. Your clear explanations of every step and procedure, as well as your gentle manner made her feel safe and respected— a rare quality that not all dentists extend to young patients. We deeply appreciate your dedication to building trust and comfort.

To Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam:
Your expertise and gentle care made my treatment painless and reassuring. Despite the complexity of scaling, polishing, fillings, and extractions, the entire process was painless and transparent. The clear, pressure-free explanations and the fact that I experienced no pain even after extractions speaks volumes about your expertise and exceptional care.

We look forward to our next visit this December for my daughter’s check-up and my molar implants.

To the Front-Desk Team:
Your warm welcome helped set a positive tone for our visits. Thank you for your professionalism and patience in explaining billing details and attending to us warmly.

Once again, thank you all for your exceptional care and professionalism.

With sincere appreciation 💐

Made an appointment for cleaning and a possible root canal treatment. Very satisfied about the treatment and cleaning. Root canal was not necessary ,only filling a cavity. A job well done! A don’t remember the doctors and assistants name, but they did a great job. 10p% happy.

It was my first time filling a cavity and the doctor was incredibly gentle, caring and understanding. She filled a really deep cavity with no pain at all just a tiny bit of discomfort! Will be coming back to get all my teeth done here

Super pleased with the service. Everyone there was great and very kind! Got my teeth clean in and out and feels so much better.

Thank you Nan also for calling back and getting my appointment done sooner than later.

I had a check up, teeth cleaning and a wisdom tooth removal at Edelweiss. Everything went very well, the doctors are super professional, the clinic is clean, all the staff do their best to make sure the patients are taken care of.

Highly recommended.

I traveled for other medical procedures and decided to see a dentist since I had been postponing it for years due to difficulties and previous experiences in my home country. With so many clinics in Thailand, it was hard to choose, but I went with Edelweiss Dental because the reception staff was very accommodating despite my restricted schedule.

The dentists and support staff are exceptional. They take the time to explain what is needed, give you options, and are open to any questions. They listen to your feedback during the procedure and explain each step as they perform it. The nurses anticipate your needs, like saliva suction, without you having to ask.

I saw two different specialists, and both were outstanding. I'm actually writing this review while still numb from the anesthetic. I have a wisdom tooth extraction coming up and will update afterward. Highly recommended, with reasonable prices for the excellent service provided.

The Service and Experience I cannot complain, absolute 5* Service & Treatment, the Doctors and Staff explained everything very clearly, I am having some major Dental work, so I will be visiting another couple of times from the UK, the pricing compared to the UK, is very reasonable and affordable, will 100% recommend to anyone.

My partner and I weren't very happy with the service at this Edelweiss clinic.So he decided not to go ahead with the rest.The other Edelweiss clinic we went to was Excellent....The service, professionalism here was well below what I expected.The clean wasn't fantastic, my front tooth on my partial had a slight chip on the bottom that I asked to get fixed.Now that tooth feels rough, I had a look and there are tiny holes in the false tooth, looks bad.Wish I never went there.No acknowledgement when entering, just no front desk service, 2 girls were busy on their phone.Didn't really give a toss.The whole experience was terrible..Get yourself some new staff..I wouldn't recommend this clinic at all or go back there.
